name: KLK
recent: KLK 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，并发布了月度产量数据和季度产量披露。新闻方面，公司就印尼火烧涉及区域作出说明，并披露印尼供气纠纷的仲裁裁决已收到，预计不会对盈利造成重大影响。此外，公司任命 Lee Jia Zhang 为首席执行官。
notable: 公司收到印尼供气纠纷的仲裁裁决，并表示不会对盈利造成重大影响。
公司任命 Lee Jia Zhang 为首席执行官。
公司就印尼火烧事件作出说明，称大部分火点源自特许经营区以外，且均已扑灭。
risks: EPF 在多个交易日持续申报股东权益变动，需留意其持股变化。
新闻提及公司与印尼火烧事件的关联，相关情况仍需关注。

recent_en: KLK's recent announcements were mainly EPF substantial shareholder changes, along with monthly and quarterly production disclosures. In the news, the company addressed fires linked to its Indonesian concession area and said the arbitral award in an Indonesian gas supply dispute has been received with no material impact on earnings. It also appointed Lee Jia Zhang as Chief Executive Officer.
notable_en: The company received the arbitral award in an Indonesian gas supply dispute and said it will not have a material impact on earnings.
The company appointed Lee Jia Zhang as Chief Executive Officer.
The company addressed fires in Indonesia, saying most fire points originated outside its concession area and all have been put out.
risks_en: EPF made repeated substantial shareholder change filings over multiple trading days; its shareholding changes warrant monitoring.
News reports linked the company to fires in Indonesia; the situation remains to be monitored.
earnings_en: For the period ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 7,054,147,000 and net loss was MYR 1,344,429,000, with a net margin of -19.1%. Revenue rose 7.7% QoQ and 9.7% YoY, while net income fell 557.2% QoQ and 487.9% YoY.
